import sys


def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    n = data[0]
    del data[0]
    values = data

    positions = sorted(range(n), key=values.__getitem__)

    left_tree = [0] * (n + 1)
    right_tree = [0] * (n + 1)
    total_right = 0
    answer = 0
    mod = 1_000_000_007

    for position in positions:
        index = position + 1
        right_weight = n - position

        left_sum = 0
        right_prefix_sum = 0
        node = index - 1
        while node:
            left_sum += left_tree[node]
            right_prefix_sum += right_tree[node]
            node -= node & -node

        coefficient = (
            index * right_weight
            + right_weight * left_sum
            + index * (total_right - right_prefix_sum)
        )
        answer = (answer + values[position] * coefficient) % mod

        node = index
        while node <= n:
            left_tree[node] += index
            right_tree[node] += right_weight
            node += node & -node

        total_right += right_weight

    print(answer)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
